profile.name: Aryan Chaudhary
profile.title: UI/UX Designer
profile.tagline: Designing digital experiences with precision. Every pixel is a calculated move.
profile.bio: A first-year design student treating every interface like a tactical drop. Mapping the field, picking the right loadout, executing clean.
profile.personalTouch: Outside the dropzone I play strategy games, build bad mechanical keyboards, and study how good HUDs guide attention without screaming.
profile.goals: Build a portfolio of shipped tactical interfaces; learn motion design properly; intern at a product team that values craft.
